fixed: digital painting portrait, single character, upper body, 4:5 vertical, head-and-shoulders framing, eyes at 30% from top, flat single-color background <TINT>, soft circular vignette, no scenery, muted palette, controlled brushwork, semi-realistic, even key light from front-left, sharp focus on face, no text, no watermark, no border
negative: photo, 3d render, anime, chibi, exaggerated proportions, multiple people, full body, hands near face, weapon pointed at viewer, busy background, scenery, landscape, text, watermark, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, blur, oversaturated, lens flare, modern clothing

class.제: wearing a structured high-collar fleet dress uniform with rank insignia and a long coat, squared to camera, one hand resting on a table edge, bearing of command
class.강: wearing matte armor plating over a padded underlayer, torso turned three-quarters, pauldron catching the light, a close-combat blade sheathed at the shoulder
class.파: wearing a fitted flight suit with harness straps and forearm controls, helmet set beside them, younger face, lean and alert
class.참: wearing a layered scholar's robe with a narrow sash, holding a thin data-slate or a writing brush, leaning slightly forward as if mid-thought
class.관: wearing a plain administrator's robe with a single clasp, hands folded, upright and composed, no held objects

disposition.명사: dignified level gaze meeting the viewer, chin neither raised nor lowered, formal reserve
disposition.무뢰: gaze angled off past the viewer, faint smirk, careless ease in the shoulders
disposition.실무: near-neutral expression, steady measured gaze, no performance
disposition.야심: eyes lifted slightly or scanning sidelong, weighing what is in front of them, contained hunger
disposition.절의: set jaw, firm closed mouth, unwavering frontal stare
disposition.군주: presence of a ruler, direct unhurried gaze, aware of being watched

faction_accent_none: plain dark garment, no faction piping

trait_marker.독안: black eye patch over one eye
trait_marker.만신창이: old scars visible on face and neck
